facts.fact: Internet Society Pulse says Angola recorded gains in reported IXP memberships and domestic network coverage between March 2019 and March 2026 without a rise in its reported IXP count, which shows networks as members of a reported exchange.
Internet Society Pulse says Burundi's reported IXP count, memberships and coverage all rose between March 2019 and March 2026.

Internet Society Pulse says the Republic of Congo recorded gains in reported IXP memberships and coverage between March 2019 and March 2026 without a rise in its reported IXP count, which shows networks as members of a reported exchange.

CPV.note: Named only for domestic network coverage rising from 0 to 100 percent; no exchange stated.
